description:
Classify the health of a durable telemetry outbox (backlog, delivery, audit and storage) from
        counters you supply: healthy, degraded or faulted, with the reasons. Does not read live
        equipment, secret stores or remote journals.
        Example: inspect_telemetry_delivery_health(snapshot={"pending": 12, "capacity": 1000, "delivered": 480, "attempted": 492, "failed": 0, "rejected": 0, "audit_failures": 0, "storage_errors": 0, "connected": true, "faulted": false, "recording": true}).

snapshot.description: Counters you supply as JSON: pending, capacity, delivered, attempted, failed, rejected, audit_failures, storage_errors, and the flags connected, faulted, recording. Nothing is read from equipment.
snapshot.title: Snapshot

name: inspect_telemetry_delivery_health
title: Check telemetry delivery health
